file_insights.changes_summary: Added date range filter inputs to supplier list template
key_modifications: Reduced search input column width from col-md-8 to col-md-6
Added two new date input fields (date_from and date_to) with col-md-2 width each
Adjusted button group column from col-md-4 to col-md-2 to accommodate new filters
Updated pagination links to include date_from and date_to query parameters with conditional rendering

patterns_discovered.pattern: Conditional query parameter handling in templates
patterns_discovered.description: Uses Django template conditionals ({% if variable %}) to optionally include search, date_from, and date_to parameters in pagination links, preventing empty parameters in URLs
Utilizes col-md-* classes to create flexible, proportional column layouts that adjust as filters are added

patterns_discovered.pattern: HTMX form integration with URL state management
patterns_discovered.description: Both href and hx-get attributes are kept in sync with identical query strings and hx-push-url='true' for browser history management

gotchas_discovered.issue: Query parameter duplication across multiple pagination links
gotchas_discovered.description: Date parameters must be manually added to every pagination link (previous, numbered pages, next). Changes to filter logic require updates in 3+ locations, increasing maintenance burden and error risk
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Consider refactoring to use a template macro or inclusion tag to generate pagination links with dynamic parameters

gotchas_discovered.issue: Placeholder attributes on date inputs not functional
gotchas_discovered.description: HTML date input elements ignore placeholder attributes - placeholders don't display on date inputs in most browsers
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Remove placeholder attributes or use aria-labels instead for accessibility

gotchas_discovered.issue: Inline conditional logic in URLs may impact readability
gotchas_discovered.description: Long Django template conditionals in href/hx-get attributes create difficult-to-read URLs and make the template harder to maintain
gotchas_discovered.recommendation: Precompute query strings in the view layer and pass them to the template as context variables

approach_outcome.description: Date range filter inputs successfully added to supplier list template with proper Bootstrap grid layout and pagination parameter persistence

recommendations.suggestion: Refactor pagination URL generation into a reusable template helper or custom template tag to centralize query parameter logic and reduce duplication across 3+ pagination link locations
Move query string construction to the Django view layer and pass precomputed URLs to the template as context variables to improve readability and reduce template complexity
Remove placeholder attributes from date inputs as they are not rendered, and consider adding visible labels or aria-labels for better accessibility and user guidance
Add tests to verify that date filters persist correctly across pagination and that query parameters are properly encoded in URLs
